Hi Pradip, 

 

I think you should use scale_colour_manual(" ", values=xcolor) instead of scale_colour_manual(" ", value=xcolor). values instead of value.

 

Then it works fine.

single_yr

xcolor <- c("White"= "#996633", "Black"= "#000000")


p <- ggplot(single_yr, aes(x=age, y=percent, group=race , colour=race ))+
      geom_line (size= 2) +
      scale_colour_manual(" ", value=xcolor)+        
      xlab("Age")+
      ylab("Percentage")+
